column1: # Spanish glosses for the example words on the new-kanji intro card
# Authored by the Tamagotcho project; distributed with the packs under CC BY-SA
# EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0) and, where a draft kept its suggestion, from FreeDict's
# eng-spa dictionary (WikDict, from Wiktionary via DBnary, CC BY-SA 3.0). No
# text comes from JMdict's own Spanish glosses.
#   level    the deck level the word was picked for (context only)
#   kanji    the card kanji it was picked for, comma-separated if several (context only)
#   word     the word as written      } the key the builder looks up
#   en       JMdict_e's first English glosses of the word (context only)
#   es       the Spanish gloss shown on the intro: short (at most 24 characters),
#            the sense the word has for this kanji, lower-case unless a proper noun
#   status   draft (written for review; the builder ignores it), ok (reviewed;
#            the builder uses it) or skip (not an example: the builder takes the
#   note     empty when the draft is confident; "CHECK: <reason>" when it needs a
#            closer look (FreeDict's suggestion is quoted when the draft changed it);
# Review rule: the maintainer reviews a level as a whole, looks hard at the
# CHECK rows, fixes `es` where needed and sets each row to ok or skip. Only ok
# rows reach a pack; a level with unreviewed rows shows those words without a
